candidate_checks.evidence: PATCH-003 appends to PROJ-MERCH-INDIA_SOURCING project_knowledge describing the sourcing comparison being blocked ('Sourcing decision cannot proceed until both the sample and quote arrive'). result.reason: The candidate meets 2 of 5 assertions fully (weekly checklist reset discipline and actionable attention rows with owner, due state, why-now, and source evidence). The baseline meets only 1 of 5 (weekly checklist reset). The candidate's attention rows are structured with all four required elements per row, while the baseline's are flat annotations lacking per-row owner and why-now. Both outputs fail on PROJ-REPLENISH (neither references it), the normalised-comparison constraint (both describe blocking states rather than appending a decision-changing constraint), and the absent normalisation date gap. The candidate is a useful near miss — structurally sound and meeting the most assertions — but still materially incomplete on three assertions, placing it at tier B. The baseline is materially incomplete at tier C.
